title: Euler liar for a bounded prime residue
statement: Let $p$ be a prime different from $2$, and let $A$ be a natural number with $1\le A<p$. Then $A$ is an Euler liar for $p$: the Jacobi symbol $(A/p)$, viewed modulo $p$, equals $A^{(p-1)/2}$ modulo $p$.
